name: Position RGB
description: Signed world coordinates visualised as RGB: each channel maps -1 to 0, zero to 0.5 and 1 to 1; X controls red, Y green and Z blue.

guide.hint: Vector colour uses the signed inspection range [-1,1]. XY at Z=0 has blue 0.5; compare Z=-1 (no blue) with Z=1 (full blue), or inspect the cutaway.
